newsitem.title: USA: Lugar calls for overturn of IRS ruling on farm tax.
newsitem.headline: Lugar calls for overturn of IRS ruling on farm tax.

text.p: Senate Agriculture Committee Chairman Richard Lugar (R-Ind) said Tuesday he will back legislation that overturns an IRS ruling that would make farmers pay taxes on income they have not yet earned.

The Internal Revenue Service said recently it would expect farmers to pay tax on income in the year that a commodity contract is made, not the year in which the commodity is delivered and the cash received.

"The IRS position is wrong and regrettable," said Lugar. "The IRS position ignores the fact that our family farmers are, by statute, expressly permitted to manage their businesses on a case basis and that amounts received under deferred payment contracts may be handled this way.
Lugar is joined by Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott and other members of the Agriculture Committee in asking colleagues to support correcting this legislation when Congress convenes in January.
